note_selection_rule: Section route selected before new scores; require nonempty sections and at least one valid Main backlink in every paper. Report per-paper counts and empty-route fallback. No replacement based on scores.

context_budget.selection: ranked whole chunks; stop before first overflow; no skipping or truncation; overlapping text still consumes budget

denominators: all expected required groups; unresolved groups cannot succeed
comparison_gate: Identical source/question/gold hashes and evaluable set. Incomplete gold remains diagnostic, not a release winner.
historical_policy: Rescore preserved rankings only after payload hash and every returned chunk ID/source identity are validated; original results remain unchanged. Old timings are excluded from current end-to-end claims.
